name: Oracle Ping Flood
summary: Attacker rapid-fires trades against the oracle pair to bias the TWAP window and open a manipulated-price trade. Detector flags deviation velocity > threshold.
expectedOutcome: Burst of PendingTxEvents. OraclePair.getReserves() deviation per block exceeds 300 bps. Detector emits ORACLE_MANIPULATION verdict. Defense pauses the oracle consumer.

steps.text: Oracle flood begins: 12 trades in 2 blocks
TWAP skew: +480 bps in one block — above 300 bps threshold
Oracle consumer paused. Attacker's manipulated-price trade reverts.
